card.name: Route words: by way of, through, via
card.fires_on: Words that introduce a route or intermediary, such as "of" in "by way of", "through", "via" and "way" in "this way". They come before the channel, path or medium used.

modes.label: By way of
modes.description: The word "of" or "way" in phrases meaning by means of something.
modes.example: by way<< of>> tubewells, ignoring dugwells

modes.label: Through / via a medium
modes.description: "through" or "via" before a channel such as breast milk, a tube or a transit point.
modes.example: infants exposed to other benzodiazepines<< through>> breast milk

modes.label: Via in drug handling
modes.description: "via" after a drug name or metabolism, before a route or pathway.
modes.example: ABIVEN<< via>> a Y-site due to precipitation.

card.writes: It favors words for indirect routes or intermediaries, such as indirect, intermediary and the Chinese words for 间接 and 途径.
card.plain: It fires on little words like through, via and by way of that say what path or medium something travels by.
